en: A monochrome panoramic view of a small town set in a hilly rural landscape. The foreground shows fields, orchards and scattered houses, while the middle distance contains clusters of two- and three‑story buildings typical of Central European village architecture. Forested hills form the horizon. In the upper left corner, the word "Königsbrück." is printed in red Gothic-style type, identifying the town.
